heroSection.title: Omada Cloud-Based Controller
heroSection.description: The Omada Cloud-Based Controller is a component of the Omada Software Defined Networking (SDN) platform, offering 100% centralized cloud management for Omada access points, JetStream switches, and Omada routers. It eliminates the need for additional hardware controller investment and on-site installation.

features.name: Cloud-Based
features.description: The controller exists entirely in the cloud, allowing management from anywhere at any time.

features.name: Zero-Touch Provisioning
features.description: Enables remote deployment and configuration of multi-site networks, reducing the need for on-site engineers and lowering deployment costs.

features.name: Centralized Management
features.description: Provides a single interface for managing all connected network devices.

features.name: No Hardware Investment
features.description: There's no need to purchase or install a physical controller on the customer's premises.

features.name: Easy Monitoring
features.description: An intuitive dashboard allows for real-time network status monitoring, traffic distribution analysis, and access to network logs and alerts.

features.name: Omada App Support
features.description: Management can also be done conveniently through the Omada app.

features.name: High Reliability
features.description: The service guarantees 99.9% SLA availability, with 24/7 automated fault detection and geographically isolated backup servers.

features.name: User Privacy Protection
features.description: TP-Link Omada separates network management data from user data, ensuring user traffic does not pass through the cloud.

features.name: 100% Centralized Cloud Management
features.description: Provides unified control over all Omada network devices from anywhere, anytime, via a web browser or the Omada app. Eliminates the need for additional hardware controllers or on-premise installation.

features.name: Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP)
features.description: Enables remote deployment and configuration of multi-site networks without requiring on-site engineers, reducing deployment costs and effort. Allows for automatic configuration and enrollment of devices directly from the cloud.

features.name: Enhanced Security
features.description: Separates network management data from user traffic, ensuring user privacy as no user data passes through the cloud.

features.name: Intelligent Monitoring
features.description: Features an easy-to-use dashboard for real-time network status, traffic distribution, network condition logs, and abnormal event warnings. It also includes network topology mapping for quick troubleshooting.

features.name: Simplified Maintenance
features.description: Offers features like auto channel selection and power adjustment for Wi-Fi optimization, batch management, multi-site management, and remote firmware updates.

heroSection.title: Omada Design Hub
heroSection.description: The Omada Design Hub is a free, online network planning tool developed by TP-Link, designed to help individuals and businesses efficiently design and deploy their network infrastructure.

designHub.whatItDoes: A free, AI-powered network planning tool developed by TP-Link. It is designed to streamline the process of designing and optimizing network topology and simulating Wi-Fi coverage.

features.name: Visualized Network Planning
features.description: It offers a visual platform for planning networks, allowing users to easily lay out their network designs.

features.name: AI-Powered Tools
features.description: The hub incorporates AI tools for tasks such as automatically detecting and drawing walls from uploaded floor plans and suggesting optimal placement for access points (APs).

features.name: Device Deployment and Simulation
features.description: Users can deploy various Omada devices like APs, gateways, and switches, and simulate Wi-Fi coverage with heatmaps to optimize device placement.

features.name: Customization and Reporting
features.description: It allows for customization of design elements like wall types and cable preferences. The tool can also generate comprehensive network design reports, including topology maps, device lists, and equipment costs.

faqs.question: What is Omada Cloud-Based Controller (CBC)?
faqs.answer: The Omada Cloud-Based Controller (CBC) is a new controller existing entirely in the cloud for the Omada Software Defined Networking (SDN) platform. It provides centralized cloud management of gateways, switches, and access points from a single interface.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of Omada CBC over the local controller?
faqs.answer: The Omada CBC offers centralized cloud management for Omada access points, JetStream switches, and Omada routers, all controlled from a single interface. There is no additional hardware controller investment or installation required on customer premises.

faqs.question: How do I charge for using Omada CBC?
faqs.answer: For management and configurations on the Omada Cloud-Based Controller, each device should be bound with an activated license. You can visit the Omada Cloud website, log into your TP-Link ID, and purchase licenses for your Omada devices.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial for Omada CBC?
faqs.answer: Yes, each TP-Link ID is eligible for a one-time free trial, with 10 licenses valid for 30 days. You can apply for this on the license subscription website.

faqs.question: What should I do if I no longer want to manage a device on Omada Cloud-Based Controller?
faqs.answer: You can unbind the license from the device, and then the device cannot be managed on the cloud-based controller. You can assign the available license to another device. Note that the license will keep ticking after activation whether it is bound with a device, and the unbinding times are limited.

faqs.question: Does Omada CBC support all Omada products? Why can't I add my Omada products to CBC?
faqs.answer: No, not all Omada products support the Omada CBC. You should visit the 'Devices Supported by Omada Cloud-Based Controller' page to view compatible devices.
